facts.business: Servotech Renewable Power System Ltd. integrates power electronics, renewable energy, and electric mobility to deliver intelligent energy solutions across diverse sectors.
key_risks: Regulatory compliance risk: Fines levied by NSE for delayed/non-compliance with Regulation 17(1A) of SEBI LODR Regulations
Tax litigation risk: Pending income tax demands for A.Y. 2016-17 (Rs 143.36 Lacs), A.Y. 2017-18 (Rs 252.12 Lacs and Rs 275 Lacs)
VAT demand risk: Net demand of Rs 6.52 Lacs from Haryana VAT Department for short submission of statutory forms
Warrant forfeiture risk: 58,50,000 warrants forfeited due to non-exercise within prescribed period
facts.related_party_note: The Related Party Transactions Policy as approved by the Board is uploaded on the Company's website at https://investor.servotech.in/corporate-governance/policies.php
